name: Covert Cups | 200mg Rosin Chocolate Treats | Peanut Butter
description:
Take a bite out of the ordinary with our HASH ROSIN CUPS! Delicious and discrete, our HASH ROSIN Cups are a great way to get high on the low. Each package comes with 8 HASH ROSIN Cups totaling 200mg THC.

Packing 25mg THC into each cup, this tasty treat is the perfect pick-me up, specially packaged to microdose your experience.

Covert Cups hash rosin chocolate edible cups are cannabis-infused chocolates known for our high potency, amazing taste and exceptional quality.
